title: Cerebrovascular EveNts in Patients Undergoing TranscathetER Aortic Valve Implantation With Balloon-expandable Valves Versus Self-expandable Valves.
brief_summary: The aim of this collaborative analysis is to evaluate stroke rates and mortality in patients undergoing TAVI with the self-expandable MCV prosthesis compared to the balloon-expandable ES valve. In the absence of large randomized controlled trials, we will conduct a large collaborative patient-pooled meta-analysis on 30-day stroke and mortality in patients undergoing primary transfemoral TAVI with either MCV or ES valve.
raw_criteria:

* patients undergoing transfemoral transcatheter aortic valve procedures

Exclusion Criteria:
